content: Vite is the recommended build tool for React + Three.js + Matter.js educational projects as of 2025-2026. Vite provides fast HMR (Hot Module Replacement) which is critical for development iterations in educational settings. It uses ES modules natively and has minimal config. CRA is deprecated and creates larger bundles. Next.js is overkill for simple slide projects. Vite + React + Three.js + Matter.js is the modern standard. Vite 5.x with React 18 and @vitejs/plugin-react is the recommended combo.
